meaning:
κατα-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Isa.40:19, 28, (בָּרָא), etc. ;]
to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.7:27; οἶκον, Heb.3:3-4; σκηνήν, Heb.9:2, 6; κιβωτόν, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., Luk.1:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to…
For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved…
